summary: Quiet residential kerb near the west corner, homes about 11 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 11 to 22 m away on the south side and houses face the street on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grassy corner verge and the odd parked car; room to pull in.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street but no clear overnight habit.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
Steep further along: up to 9% grade, mean 4.6%
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees give patchy shade from the south side.

best_section.where: Salisbury Street kerb just east of the western corner, by the grass verge
